body.interpretation: Standard UE native server-RPC body. Prologue performs the non-zero-guarded 64-bit increment of the FFrame field at +0x20 (Result): 0 stays 0, non-zero n becomes n+1 (a no-op for this void RPC). Then it virtually CALLs vtable+0xb38 (the bool validation hook ServerReleaseSecondaryFire_Validate). On false it loads the wide string at 0x1463b01c0 ("ServerReleaseSecondaryFire_Validate") into RCX and tail-jumps to RPC_ValidateFailed at 0x142d6e0f0. On true it tail-jumps to vtable+0xb40 (the implementation hook ServerReleaseSecondaryFire_Implementation). No parameters are read (reflection params are empty); no return value is produced.

field_proofs: FFrame field at +0x20 is the native Result/Parms pointer (standard UE native calling convention; RDX is the FFrame*). The guard-increment matches the sibling thunk pattern used across the project (e.g. work/q27-11100501 AFortCreativeMoveTool handlers).
RPC_ValidateFailed is the shared engine helper at 0x142d6e0f0 (named by the capture json 'called' entry).
cross_validation: Body structure (validate -> RPC_ValidateFailed on false -> implementation) is the canonical UE native server-RPC shape; the only function-specific datum (the validate name) is proven by the embedded wide string, not inferred.
Reflection flags 0x80220cc0 and empty param list are consistent with a parameterless Net|NetServer RPC.
remaining_concerns: The validate/implementation hooks are dispatched virtually (vtable 0xb38/0xb40); a derived-class override of either hook would change behavior. The .inc preserves the virtual dispatch (calls the member hooks by name) rather than inlining a concrete target, matching the project convention.
The concrete vtable targets for slots 0xb38/0xb40 were not independently resolved in this run; they are not needed for the body because the hooks are referenced by their reflected names.
